meta.title: Age Calculator — Calculate Exact Age from Birthdate
meta.description: Calculate your exact age in years, months, and days from a given birthdate. Free and instant — no signup needed.

howItWorks: Enter your date of birth in the date picker.
The calculator finds the difference between your birthdate and today's date.
It breaks down the difference into years, months, and days for a precise age.
howToUse: Select your birth date using the date picker.
Optionally select a target date (defaults to today).
View your exact age in years, months, and days instantly.

faq.question: How accurate is the age calculator?
faq.answer: The calculator accounts for leap years and varying month lengths, giving you an exact age down to the day.

faq.question: Can I calculate age as of a future date?
faq.answer: Yes. Change the target date to any future or past date to calculate age as of that specific date.

faq.question: Is my data stored?
faq.answer: No. All calculations happen in your browser. Your birthdate is never sent to a server or stored.

examples.title: Age from birthdate
examples.description: Calculate age from a specific birthdate to today.
